items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: grade-runner.ts and triage-cli-runner.ts spawn via uv run per the reported fix (AUFGABE 1/2); regression guard test added (AUFGABE 4); SHIPWRIGHT_GRADE_COMPLIANCE_ROOT passthrough verified. AUFGABE 3 (reorder resolvePython's own probe order) deliberately out of scope — documented in the iterate spec's Out of Scope section; neither fixed call site uses resolvePython any more, so it closes no vulnerable path.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: uv-missing and spawn-failure paths return honest engine-unavailable outcomes with the existing repair command; no unhandled null/undefined introduced.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: shell:false preserved (execFile unchanged); the `--` end-of-options separator before the target is preserved; no new user-input path; no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New/updated tests assert on argv shape, env contents, and outcome status (behavior), not internals; each function has a happy path and an engine-unavailable/error path.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New uv-runner.ts (59 lines) mirrors readiness-probe-path.ts conventions; every touched file stays under the 300-line guideline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized-format change — this changes subprocess invocation (argv/env), not a wire/file format. GradeOutcome and the triage CLI JSON envelope are unchanged.
